parameters.query: =INSERT INTO engagement_events (account, contact, source, event_type, campaign, value, occurred_at, metadata) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT a.account FROM actions a WHERE a.utm_campaign = '{{ $json.campaign_esc }}' AND '{{ $json.campaign_esc }}' <> '' LIMIT 1), NULLIF('{{ $json.account_esc }}',''), 'unknown'), NULLIF('{{ $json.contact_esc }}',''), 'linkedin', '{{ $json.event_type }}', NULLIF('{{ $json.campaign_esc }}',''), {{ $json.value }}, '{{ $json.occurred_esc }}'::timestamptz, '{{ $json.metadata_esc }}'::jsonb WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM engagement_events e WHERE e.source = 'linkedin' AND ((NULLIF('{{ $json.event_id_esc }}','') IS NOT NULL AND e.metadata->>'linkedin_event_id' = '{{ $json.event_id_esc }}') OR (NULLIF('{{ $json.event_id_esc }}','') IS NULL AND e.event_type = '{{ $json.event_type }}' AND COALESCE(e.campaign,'') = '{{ $json.campaign_esc }}' AND COALESCE(e.contact,'') = '{{ $json.contact_esc }}' AND e.occurred_at = '{{ $json.occurred_esc }}'::timestamptz))) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
